data.one_liner: Flutter widget library for social authentication buttons like Google, Apple, and Facebook.
data.what_it_does: Provides pre-styled UI buttons for popular social network authentication (Google, Apple, Facebook, Twitter). It supports multiple button types (default, icon, secondary), icon types (outlined, secondary), disabled states, loading indicators, and custom button styling.
use_when: You need standardized UI buttons for social login providers.
You want to easily customize the theme, colors, and types of your authentication buttons.
avoid_when: You need the actual authentication logic or backend integration, as this package only provides the UI widgets.
strengths: Supports multiple popular social networks out of the box.
Offers various button types, icon styles, and group layouts.
Follows system theme mode and supports dark mode.
weaknesses: Contains only the UI components, requiring separate backend or auth packages for functionality.
Not documented for non-listed social networks without using CustomAuthButton.
data.setup_notes: Add to pubspec.yaml dependencies and import the library.

alternatives.name: google_sign_in
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you specifically need the complete Google sign-in flow logic rather than just UI buttons.

alternatives.name: sign_in_with_apple
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you specifically need Apple's native sign-in button and implementation.
